title: Example Text Meta Bank
description: Schema for example_text_meta_bank_N.json: metadata applied to every sentence extracted from example_text_bank_N.txt. Keys other than the ones below are ignored.

groupIds.description: Numeric group IDs given to every sentence of the text bank.

tags.description: Tags of the text bank's file. They reference Yomitan tag_bank_*.json definitions (schema: '../../yomitan/dictionary-tag-bank-v3-schema.json'); blank tags are ignored.

stats.description: Stats given to every sentence of the text bank.
